title: Host-client coverage matrix with a version-stamped evidence anchor per cell
question: Question: which supported host client was never exercised end-to-end? A cell may be marked RUN only when a receipt exists that names the client VERSION under which it ran.

answer: Declared host clients never exercised end-to-end on this Linux worktree: Antigravity/agy, Claude Code, Codex CLI. RUN clients: (none). Phase 4 compatibility-matrix artifacts (ARC-0095 / TST-0049) are absent (command-center/receipts/ARC-0095.json, command-center/phase4/compatibility-matrix.json); no extra generic MCP hosts were added from the matrix (count=0). NOT-CHECKED is used for absent clients, never PASS and never NOT-APPLICABLE.

reviewer.notes: No RUN cell exists on this box, so the catalog's 're-run one RUN cell on a client the author did not use' is not instantiable. The independent control is probe2: installer-exit rejection, absent-client classification, and both-states manifest corruption.

evidence.claim: Claude Code, Codex CLI, and Antigravity/agy are the declared host-client set for this unit.
A RUN cell requires a client version string; otherwise it is NEVER-RUN.
Installer exit code alone cannot mark a cell RUN; inside-client hook_fired or command_resolved is required.
An absent client classifies NOT-CHECKED with an install step, never PASS and never NOT-APPLICABLE.
Corrupting the plugin manifest turns the inside-client probe red (hooks unloaded).
